page.title: Diagnostics
page.description: Checks on this server, its speed, and a bundle to share when asking for help.

checks.heading: Health checks
checks.summary: {fail, plural, =0 {No problems} one {# problem} other {# problems}}, {warn, plural, =0 {no warnings} one {# warning} other {# warnings}}

database.title: Database server
database.unreachable: Not answering. Pages that read data will fail until it does.

hostAgent.title: Host agent
hostAgent.limited: Limited edition: updates, deploys and disk cleanup are not available from here.
hostAgent.silent: The host agent stopped answering, so updates and deploys are paused. It usually recovers within a minute.

updates.title: Updates
updates.behind: {behind, plural, =0 {An update is available} one {# update behind} other {# updates behind}}. Running {version}.
updates.unreachable: Could not check for updates right now.

disk.title: Disk space
disk.critical: Almost full: {freeGb} GB free. Deploys and updates may fail.
disk.unreadable: The disk could not be read from here.

edge.title: Routing
edge.ok: {count, plural, one {# route file} other {# route files}} in place.
edge.empty: Empty route file: {files}. Every address it serves is down until it is written again.
edge.unreadable: The route files could not be read from here.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.ok: {count, plural, =0 {No addresses to check} one {The address answers} other {All # addresses answer}}.
addresses.unreachable: Could not check the addresses right now.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.expiring: {host}: expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
certificate.expired: {host}: expired {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago.
certificate.untrusted: {host}: browsers do not trust this certificate.
certificate.unreachable: {host}: could not reach it from this server to read the certificate.
certificate.noDomain: No public domain is set for this dashboard.

dns.title: DNS
dns.unresolved: {host} does not resolve. Check its DNS record.
dns.noDomain: No public domain is set for this dashboard.

clock.title: Clock
clock.skewed: Off by {seconds} s. Sign-in codes and certificates can fail.
clock.unreachable: Could not reach the internet to compare the time.

fix.done: Done. The check was run again.
fix.failed: That did not work. The check below shows where it stands.

speed.heading: Speed test
speed.description: Measured from this server to a public test service (Cloudflare), not from your browser. Uses about 12 MB.
speed.limited: Limit reached. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

bundle.heading: Support bundle
bundle.description: A zip file to share when asking for help. Passwords, keys and tokens are never included.

files.diagnosis: The results of the checks above
files.config: Settings: safe values in full, the rest by name only
